_meta.purpose: Configuration for the grading engine + URS computation.
_meta.owner: TEAM B (logic) / TEAM D (verified standard values)
_meta.rule: Primary grading now uses the NCCF rule engine (nccf_specifications.json). This config controls the LEGACY MVP scoring (backward compat) and some shared settings.
_meta.how_to_edit: Tune only `mvp_scoring`. NCCF thresholds are in nccf_specifications.json.

mvp_scoring._note: Legacy MVP heuristic. Used when use_nccf_engine=false or for backward-compatible quality_score/grade fields.

urs._note: Legacy URS formula. Post-NCCF, URS% is derived from the rule engine (grade_urs_count / total). This legacy formula is preserved for backward-compat compute_urs().
urs.status: LEGACY — NCCF rule engine is now primary

size_thresholds._note: Legacy size threshold. NCCF specs define per-specification size ranges in nccf_specifications.json.
size_thresholds.status: LEGACY — NCCF spec ranges are authoritative

official_standards_TO_VERIFY.grade_thresholds: See nccf_specifications.json → grade_a / grade_urs tolerance tables
